name: False Opening
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When this target misses an Action before your next turn, you may move 1 unit without triggering its movement Reactions.

name: Heel Catch
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and make it Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow by 1.
surge2_html: On a hit, move the target 1 unit sideways.
rider_html: Choose an adjacent empty space. When an enemy voluntarily enters it, that enemy becomes Exposed until your next turn.

name: Wrong Foot
target_html: One detected enemy within 3 units.
effect_html: On success, the target suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: On a hit, move 1 unit away from the target.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target also becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When the target declares an attack against you, you gain +1 to the targeted Defense against that attack.

name: Bait and Switch
target_html: Self; choose a visible enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move 1 unit and gain +1 Fortitude against the chosen enemy until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: A willing ally within 2 units may move 1 unit toward your vacated space.
rider_html: When the chosen enemy finishes moving adjacent to you, you may move 1 unit and make it Exposed until your next turn.

name: Slip the Attention
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move up to 2 units toward existing cover or concealment. If none is available, move 1 unit instead.
surge1_html: Increase the movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Suppress an ordinary Slowed Condition during this movement.
rider_html: When an enemy enters a space adjacent to your destination, you may move 1 unit farther into cover without triggering its movement Reactions.

name: Read the Tell
target_html: One detected enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, learn its highest Defense and make it Exposed until the start of your next turn. Ties are reported as ties.
surge1_html: Also learn its lowest Defense.
surge2_html: An ally within 3 units gains +1 Defense against the target's next attack until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When the target changes position before your next turn, you may move 1 unit toward a space with a clear view of it.

name: Borrowed Blind Spot
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. If you began in concealment, ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit toward cover after resolving.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target was Exposed when you declared this Action.
rider_html: When the target turns its attack toward another creature before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after that attack.

name: Palmed Advantage
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and make the target Distracted until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Move one unsecured small object held by the target into its space on a hit; not its weapon or signature equipment.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When the target next moves or retrieves an object before your next turn, you may move 1 unit around it and make it Exposed.

name: Count the Gaps
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and learn whether it currently has any damage-reduction benefit; learn its value, not concealed abilities.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge2_html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of its next ordinary damage reduction until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When the target receives an ordinary defensive benefit before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after that benefit resolves.

name: Doorstop Gambit
target_html: One enemy within 2 units beside an obstacle or doorway.
effect_html: On success, push the target 1 unit away from the obstacle and make it Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the push by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage on a hit.
rider_html: Mark one adjacent doorway or gap. When an enemy voluntarily crosses it, halt that movement after 1 unit; it may burn 1 die to continue.

name: Tripwire Courtesy
target_html: A line of 2 adjacent empty spaces within 3 units; requires loose cord or similar material.
effect_html: Unopposed. The line is difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. The trap is visible to creatures that inspect it.
surge1_html: Increase the line to 3 spaces.
surge2_html: Move 1 unit while concealing your own approach in existing cover.
rider_html: When an enemy voluntarily crosses the line, it takes 1 Piercing Damage after crossing and becomes Exposed until your next turn. Remove the trap.

name: Pocketful of Bad Ground
target_html: One enemy within 3 units; requires loose debris or mundane trap material.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Piercing Damage. Independently, the target's space becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: An adjacent empty space also becomes difficult terrain.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When an enemy voluntarily leaves either prepared space, you may move 1 unit and make that creature Exposed until your next turn.

name: Use Their Commitment
target_html: One detected enemy within 3 units.
effect_html: On success, impose -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn; you gain +1 Fortitude against that target during the same time.
surge1_html: After a hit, move 1 unit toward or away from it.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When the target misses an attack before your next turn, it may either stay in place and become Slowed 2, or move 1 unit away from you; both expire at your next turn.

name: Knife in the Hinge
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and suppress 1 point of its equipment Fortitude against your next Cunning Action until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit around the target after the attack.
surge2_html: Suppress that point against the next attack by any creature instead.
rider_html: When this target gains cover before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after its movement ends.

name: Make Room for Trouble
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, move the target to another empty space adjacent to you and deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage.
surge1_html: You may move 1 unit before relocating it.
surge2_html: On a hit, knock the target Prone if it ends beside an obstacle.
rider_html: When an enemy attempts to pass through your vacated space, you may move 1 unit and give it -1 on its next Success Die before your next turn.

name: Too Good to Ignore
target_html: One detected enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn; you suffer -1 Fortitude against it for that duration, but gain +1 to your next Cunning Success Die against it.
surge1_html: On a hit, the target is also Exposed until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: You may end your own Fortitude penalty immediately after your next Cunning hit against it.
rider_html: When the target declares an attack against you before your next turn, you may move 2 units without triggering its movement Reactions; recheck range afterward.

name: Leave the Exit Open
target_html: Self; choose an empty visible space within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move up to 2 units toward the chosen space. Learn whether any detected enemy could currently reach that space with normal Movement.
surge1_html: Increase your movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: One willing ally within 2 units may move 1 unit toward the chosen space.
rider_html: When an enemy finishes moving into the chosen space, make it Exposed and move 1 unit away from it before your next turn.

name: Collateral Leverage
target_html: One detected enemy within 3 units beside an unattended obstacle.
effect_html: On success, the enemy is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn; you or a willing ally within 2 units may move 1 unit toward the obstacle.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow by 1.
surge2_html: On a hit, impose -1 Fortitude against the next melee attack targeting iter until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When the enemy attacks anyone other than you before your next turn, it becomes Exposed and loses 1 remaining unit of Movement that turn.

name: Under the Elbow
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. Move up to 2 units afterward, even on a miss; hit targets cannot make movement Reactions against this movement.
surge1_html: You may pass through the hit target's space, without stopping there.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When the target next closes to within 1 unit of you, you may move 1 unit away without triggering its movement Reactions.

name: Exit Behind the Noise
target_html: Self; a nearby loose object or noisy surface.
effect_html: Unopposed. Create a brief mundane distraction and move up to 3 units. You can become Hidden only if you end in actual concealment and meet the normal hiding rules.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during this movement.
surge2_html: One willing ally within 2 units may move 1 unit toward cover.
rider_html: When an enemy leaves its cover to pursue you before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after that movement.

name: Nothing Worth Hitting
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Gain +1 Fortitude against melee attacks and suppress one ordinary Slowed Condition until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit.
surge2_html: Also suppress one ordinary penalty to your Success Die until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When an enemy misses a melee attack against you, move 1 unit into a space adjacent to it; that move does not trigger movement Reactions.

name: The Gap That Wasn't There
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after moving up to 1 unit.
effect_html: Move up to 1 unit through existing concealment. On success, deal 2 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: Ignore 1 point of cover bonus.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if you were Hidden from the target when this Action was declared; attacking reveals you.
rider_html: When that target misses an Action before your next turn, you may move 2 units toward concealment without triggering its movement Reactions.

name: Inventory of Weaknesses
target_html: Up to two detected enemies within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, learn each target's lowest Defense and make each Exposed until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Also learn which target has more remaining Reaction Dice.
surge2_html: Each hit target suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When one chosen hit target gains an ordinary defensive benefit before your next turn, suppress 1 point of that benefit against the next attack before your next turn.

name: The Baited Landing
target_html: A sphere of radius 1 centered within 3 units, using mundane trap material.
effect_html: Unopposed. The area's empty spaces become difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. Choose one visible safe route through it that willing allies can use normally.
surge1_html: Extend the safe route 1 space beyond the area.
surge2_html: One enemy already in the area is Slowed 2 on a successful Fortitude check with this roll until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When an enemy voluntarily enters the area, it takes 1 Piercing Damage and is knocked Prone. This triggers once, after its entry.

name: Rigged Exchange
target_html: One adjacent enemy.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and move the target 1 unit. Independently, leave a visible mundane snare in your vacated space if you move during this Action.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit before the attack.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Damage if the target is already Slowed or Prone.
rider_html: When an enemy voluntarily enters your vacated space, it becomes Slowed 2 and Exposed until your next turn; remove the snare.

name: Fault in the Formation
target_html: Up to two adjacent enemies within 3 units of you.
effect_html: On success, each target is Slowed 1 and suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Cunning Action until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Move one hit target 1 unit sideways.
surge2_html: Deal 1 Piercing Damage to each hit target using thrown trap material.
rider_html: When a hit target ends adjacent to another enemy before your next turn, make both Exposed until your next turn.

name: Your Plan, My Timing
target_html: One detected enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, impose -2 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn. You may move 1 unit after resolving.
surge1_html: After a hit, the target becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: An ally within 3 units gains +1 to the targeted Defense against that enemy's next attack until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When this target declares an Action against you before your next turn, you may swap places with an adjacent willing ally; that ally chooses whether to become the legal target instead.

name: Dismantle the Advantage
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and end one ordinary defensive benefit worth at most +1 Defense or 1 Damage reduction. Equipment and Specialty Conditions remain.
surge1_html: Move a small unattended object in the target's space up to 2 units.
surge2_html: Deal +1 weapon Damage.
rider_html: When this target receives another ordinary defensive benefit before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after that benefit resolves.

name: Borrow the Collision
target_html: One adjacent enemy with an empty space adjacent to another enemy.
effect_html: On success, move the target 1 unit into the chosen empty space and deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage to it.
surge1_html: Knock the moved target Prone.
surge2_html: Also attack the second enemy with the same roll for 1 Bludgeoning Damage.
rider_html: When either target voluntarily moves adjacent to you before your next turn, push that creature 1 unit away and make it Exposed.

name: Double-Bluff Position
target_html: Self and an optional adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move up to 2 units, or swap places with the ally. Gain +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn, but your next Cunning Action must target an enemy within 3 units or lose this benefit.
surge1_html: The ally may move 1 unit after the swap.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary concealment penalty on your next Cunning Action until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When an enemy declares a melee attack against you before your next turn, move 1 unit and make it Exposed. Recheck its target validity afterward.

name: All Roads Lead Here
target_html: One detected enemy within 5 units; choose two empty spaces within 2 units of it.
effect_html: On success, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn. The chosen spaces become difficult terrain for that target only until the start of your next turn, representing anticipated pressure.
surge1_html: A willing ally within 3 units may move 1 unit toward either space.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is also Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: When the target voluntarily avoids both marked spaces while moving before your next turn, make it Exposed and move yourself 1 unit toward either space.

name: A Person-Shaped Absence
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary restraint until this movement ends, then move up to 3 units into cover or concealment. If no such destination exists, move 1 unit. The restraint resumes if its source still reaches you.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: End the suppressed restraint if it is mundane and you leave its source's reach.
rider_html: When an enemy enters within 1 unit of your destination, you may move 2 units farther into existing cover without triggering its movement Reactions.

name: The Prepared Escape
target_html: Self or a willing ally within 2 units beside a mundane restraint or obstacle.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary Movement penalty from a mundane restraint or terrain until the start of your next turn. The target may move 2 units.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Both you and the willing ally receive the suppression and movement.
rider_html: When a pursuer voluntarily crosses the target's starting space, it is Slowed 2 until your next turn and cannot make movement Reactions during that move.

name: Cinder Lancet
target_html: One enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Fire Damage.
surge1_html: Deal +1 Fire Damage.
surge2_html: After a hit, illuminate the target's space, removing ordinary darkness there until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Fire Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one target that already took Damage since its last turn takes +1 Damage from that card if hit.

name: Rill of Restraint
target_html: One enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Cold Damage and make it Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow by 1.
surge2_html: After a hit, pull the target 1 unit.
rider_html: Gain a Water Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: suppress one ordinary Movement penalty on yourself or one willing target of that card until the start of your next turn.

name: Bastion of Dust
target_html: One empty space within 2 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Create a temporary low earthen screen in the space until the start of your next turn. It grants +1 cover bonus across it, has 1 Wound and 0 Resilience, and vanishes when destroyed.
surge1_html: Create the screen in an adjacent space instead after seeing the roll.
surge2_html: A willing creature adjacent to it reduces its next incoming ranged Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain an Earth Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: yourself or one willing target of that card reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 before the start of your next turn.

name: Zephyr Step
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target moves up to 2 units along a clear supported path.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Ignore ground difficult terrain during this movement.
rider_html: Gain an Air Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: you may move 1 unit immediately before or after that card, without triggering movement Reactions.

name: Lucent Needle
target_html: One detected enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Radiant Damage. The target sheds visible light in its space until the start of your next turn; this does not reveal creatures other than it.
surge1_html: Ignore ordinary darkness penalties for this attack.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Light Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: ignore ordinary concealment penalties against its detected targets. This does not detect a hidden creature or bypass solid cover.

name: Aegis Minor
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The target also resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Protect a second willing creature within 1 unit of the first.
rider_html: Gain an Aether Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: increase its Success Die by 1, to a maximum of 10. This does not generate Surges.

name: Pillar of Embers
target_html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, each target takes 1 Fire Damage.
surge1_html: Exclude one chosen creature from the area.
surge2_html: One hit target gains Burning until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Fire Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one target that already took Damage since its last turn takes +1 Damage from that card if hit.

name: The Tempered Brand
target_html: One enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Fire Damage and suppress 1 point of its next ordinary Damage reduction until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Your next damaging Magecraft card against that target gains +1 on its Success Die until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: End one ordinary concealment effect on the target after a hit.
rider_html: Gain a Fire Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one target that already took Damage since its last turn takes +1 Damage from that card if hit.

name: Mantle of Flowing Glass
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary Slowed Condition on the target until the start of your next turn; it reduces its next incoming Fire Damage by 2 during that time.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit.
surge2_html: Also suppress one ordinary Burning Condition for the same duration.
rider_html: Gain a Water Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: suppress one ordinary Movement penalty on yourself or one willing target of that card until the start of your next turn.

name: Undertow Sigil
target_html: Up to two enemies within 4 units and 2 units of each other.
effect_html: On success, pull each target 1 unit toward a visible point between them. Choose one hit target to take 1 Cold Damage.
surge1_html: Pull 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: Each hit target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Water Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: suppress one ordinary Movement penalty on yourself or one willing target of that card until the start of your next turn.

name: Rampart of the Second Stone
target_html: Up to two adjacent empty spaces within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Concentration: create a connected temporary low wall. Each space grants +1 cover across it and has 1 Wound, 0 Resilience. The wall lasts while Concentration is maintained, up to 3 rounds.
surge1_html: One wall space has 2 Wounds instead of 1.
surge2_html: One willing creature adjacent to the wall reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain an Earth Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: yourself or one willing target of that card reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 before the start of your next turn.

name: Lithic Grasp
target_html: One enemy on a solid surface within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and make it Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of its ordinary Movement bonuses until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: After a hit, end one ordinary effect allowing that target to ignore difficult terrain.
rider_html: Gain an Earth Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: yourself or one willing target of that card reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 before the start of your next turn.

name: Vector of the Wandering Gale
target_html: One enemy or willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, push an enemy 2 units. A willing ally instead moves 2 units without opposition. The movement cannot pass through solid barriers.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Move the target horizontally in any direction instead of directly away; a willing ally also gains +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain an Air Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: you may move 1 unit immediately before or after that card, without triggering movement Reactions.

name: Borrowed Moment
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, the target may ignore one ordinary penalty to a Success Die when it next uses a Combat Card. This grants no Action or extra die.
surge1_html: The target also ignores difficult terrain during its next 1 unit of movement until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: The target gains +1 Composure until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Time Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one non-damaging benefit of that card ending at the start of your next turn instead ends at the end of that turn.

name: Gravitic Inclination
target_html: One enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Force Damage and pull it 1 unit toward a visible point within 2 units of it.
surge1_html: Pull 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Force Damage if the target ends adjacent to a solid obstacle.
rider_html: Gain a Space Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: choose a visible empty space within 2 units as its origin. Measure its Range and area from that space.

name: Folded Interval
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move the target to a visible empty supported space within 2 units of its current space. It must have an unobstructed path to the destination; this movement does not trigger movement Reactions.
surge1_html: Increase the displacement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: An ordinary restraint is suppressed during this movement; it resumes if its source still reaches the destination.
rider_html: Gain a Space Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: choose a visible empty space within 2 units as its origin. Measure its Range and area from that space.

name: Prism of Disclosure
target_html: Up to two detected enemies within 5 units and 2 units of each other.
effect_html: On success, each sheds light and cannot benefit from ordinary visual concealment until the start of your next turn. Choose one hit target to take 1 Radiant Damage.
surge1_html: Increase separation between targets to 4 units.
surge2_html: End one ordinary visual illusion covering a hit target's location, but not a Specialty effect.
rider_html: Gain a Light Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: ignore ordinary concealment penalties against its detected targets. This does not detect a hidden creature or bypass solid cover.

name: Vesper Curtain
target_html: A line of 3 connected spaces within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Concentration: fill the line with a temporary shadow curtain that provides concealment, not solid cover, for up to 3 rounds.
surge1_html: Bend the line once.
surge2_html: Yourself or one willing ally within 3 units gains +1 Composure against sensory effects until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Shadow Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: after resolving, choose two adjacent spaces within 3 units; they provide concealment until the start of your next turn.

name: Seal of Unmaking
target_html: One enemy or its visible ordinary magical effect within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Arcane Damage to the enemy and suppress one ordinary magical numerical bonus worth 1 until the start of your next turn. An unattended ordinary effect may be targeted against Difficulty 6 instead.
surge1_html: Also suppress 1 point of magical Movement bonus on a hit.
surge2_html: End the chosen ordinary bonus rather than suppressing it. Specialty Conditions are unaffected.
rider_html: Gain an Aether Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: increase its Success Die by 1, to a maximum of 10. This does not generate Surges.

name: Prismatic Dislocation
target_html: One enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Choose Acid, Cold or Lightning when declaring. On success, deal 1 Damage of that type and move the target 1 unit sideways.
surge1_html: Move the target 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: The target is Distracted until the start of your next turn after a hit.
rider_html: Gain a Chaos Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: change its Damage type to Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Force or Arcane. Conditions do not change.

name: Uncertain Geometry
target_html: Two adjacent empty spaces within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, create illusory steps in the spaces: willing creatures ignore difficult terrain there, and enemies treat them as difficult terrain. The steps do not support weight over gaps.
surge1_html: Add a third connected empty space.
surge2_html: One willing creature in the area gains +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Chaos Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: change its Damage type to Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Force or Arcane. Conditions do not change.

name: Furnace of the Divided Sun
target_html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 6 units.
effect_html: On success, each target takes 1 Fire Damage. Independently, the center space is brightly lit until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Exclude up to two chosen creatures.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Fire Damage to one hit target, or give one hit target Burning.
rider_html: Gain a Fire Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one target that already took Damage since its last turn takes +1 Damage from that card if hit.

name: Glacial Arrest
target_html: One enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Cold Damage and make it Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn. Independently, reduce your next incoming Fire Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: One willing ally within 2 units gains the same Fire protection.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target must burn 1 die before voluntarily moving until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Water Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: suppress one ordinary Movement penalty on yourself or one willing target of that card until the start of your next turn.

name: Citadel in Miniature
target_html: A connected line of up to 3 empty spaces within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Concentration: form a temporary waist-high wall, granting +1 cover across it. Each space has 2 Wounds and 0 Resilience. It lasts up to 3 rounds; creatures can cross a space as difficult terrain.
surge1_html: One space may provide full cover, but then blocks movement until destroyed.
surge2_html: Up to two willing creatures beside the wall reduce their next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain an Earth Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: yourself or one willing target of that card reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 before the start of your next turn.

name: Edict of the Four Winds
target_html: Up to three creatures in a cone of length 4.
effect_html: On success, push each enemy 2 units. Willing targets instead move up to 2 units in a chosen direction without opposition.
surge1_html: Increase one target's movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: One hit enemy takes 1 Force Damage; willing targets gain +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn instead.
rider_html: Gain an Air Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: you may move 1 unit immediately before or after that card, without triggering movement Reactions.

name: The Unbroken Second
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 5 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress the numerical penalties of one non-Critical Wound Condition until the start of your next turn. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 during that time. This does not postpone Wounds or incapacitation.
surge1_html: Extend the suppression through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Also suppress one ordinary penalty to the target's next Success Die until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Time Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one non-damaging benefit of that card ending at the start of your next turn instead ends at the end of that turn.

name: Singularity Knot
target_html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, pull each target 1 unit toward the center and deal 1 Force Damage. Independently, the center becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Pull each hit target 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: One hit target is knocked Prone if its movement ends adjacent to another creature or obstacle.
rider_html: Gain a Space Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: choose a visible empty space within 2 units as its origin. Measure its Range and area from that space.

name: Corridor of Impossible Nearness
target_html: Two visible empty supported spaces within 5 units of you and 3 units of each other.
effect_html: Unopposed. Concentration: connect the spaces for up to 3 rounds. A willing creature can spend 1 Movement to travel between them if a clear path exists; this is not an extra Action and cannot cross solid walls.
surge1_html: Endpoints may be 4 units apart.
surge2_html: One willing creature using the connection before your next turn gains +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Space Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: choose a visible empty space within 2 units as its origin. Measure its Range and area from that space.

name: Judgment Through the Prism
target_html: One detected enemy within 6 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 Radiant Damage and suppress its ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Learn whether an ordinary illusion is altering the target's visible outline.
surge2_html: On a hit, end one ordinary magical concealment benefit on it.
rider_html: Gain a Light Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: ignore ordinary concealment penalties against its detected targets. This does not detect a hidden creature or bypass solid cover.

name: Palace of Diminished Sight
target_html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, each target is Distracted until the start of your next turn. Independently, three chosen spaces in the area provide concealment until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Reposition one chosen shadow space to an adjacent empty space.
surge2_html: One hit target takes 1 Arcane Damage.
rider_html: Gain a Shadow Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: after resolving, choose two adjacent spaces within 3 units; they provide concealment until the start of your next turn.

name: Aegis of the Unwoven
target_html: Self and up to two willing allies within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming magical Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn; suppress one ordinary magical Success Die penalty on each for the same duration.
surge1_html: Also resist each target's next 1 unit of magical forced movement until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: One target reduces that incoming Damage by 1 more.
rider_html: Gain an Aether Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: increase its Success Die by 1, to a maximum of 10. This does not generate Surges.

name: Transposition of Contraries
target_html: Two creatures within 5 units and 2 units of each other.
effect_html: Compare against each unwilling target. Swap their spaces only if both consent or are hit and each fits. Each hit enemy also becomes Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn, even if the swap fails.
surge1_html: Targets may be 3 units apart.
surge2_html: One willing swapped creature gains +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn and may move 1 unit.
rider_html: Gain a Chaos Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: change its Damage type to Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Force or Arcane. Conditions do not change.

name: Emberglass Armature
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn. Its next successful attack before your next turn may push one damaged enemy 1 unit, as heated plates flare.
surge1_html: The push may be sideways instead.
surge2_html: Also reduce the target's next incoming Fire Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Gain a Fire Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one target that already took Damage since its last turn takes +1 Damage from that card if hit.

name: Directed Impulse
target_html: One enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Force Damage.
surge1_html: Deal +1 Force Damage.
surge2_html: On a hit, push the target 1 unit.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain for this card and hit, move 1 unit toward or away from the target after resolving.

name: The Mind Refuses
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Reduce the next incoming Damage you take by 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Gain +1 Composure against the next attack targeting you until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Extend the Damage protection to one willing ally within 2 units.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain for this card, the first creature to push or pull you before your next turn moves you 1 fewer unit.

name: Peripheral Self
target_html: One visible point within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, perceive ordinary sights and sounds from the point, without seeing through solid barriers. Your body remains aware and in place.
surge1_html: Increase range by 2 units.
surge2_html: Learn the occupied space of one ordinarily concealed creature within 1 unit of the point.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, you may move the viewpoint up to 2 units when you next move before your next turn; it must stay within 4 units of you.

name: A Thought Out of Step
target_html: One detected enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: On a hit, it is also Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Deal 1 Psychic Damage on a hit.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and hit, learn which of the target's Fortitude and Composure is lower.

name: Still Water Within
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Do not accept Strain on this card. Remove 1 Strain and gain +1 Composure against the next psychic attack before your next turn.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary distraction penalty until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Enter Still Water Trance until the end of your next turn: if you accept no Strain during an entire turn, you may burn 1 Action Die at its end to remove 1 Strain.

name: Shared Bearings
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target gains +1 Fortitude against the next ranged attack targeting it and resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit.
surge2_html: The target also gains +1 Composure against sensory deception until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, you know the location of the protected creature through ordinary concealment until your next turn, but not through solid barriers.

name: Kinetic Puncture
target_html: One detected enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Force Damage; ignore 1 point of cover bonus if you can detect the target's occupied space.
surge1_html: Deal +1 Force Damage.
surge2_html: Learn whether the target's cover is solid or only visual.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and hit, the target cannot provide cover for another creature against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.

name: Intrusive Chorus
target_html: Up to two enemies within 4 units and 2 units of each other.
effect_html: On success, each is Distracted until the start of your next turn; choose one hit target to take 1 Psychic Damage.
surge1_html: Each hit target's next spoken combat coordination is perceptible to you, without reading private thoughts, until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Deal 1 Psychic Damage to the second hit target.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, mark one hit target: you detect its space through ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn, but not through solid walls.

name: Nociceptive Spike
target_html: One living enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Psychic Damage and make the target Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase the Slow by 1.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and hit, suppress one ordinary pain penalty on yourself until your next turn. This does not suppress a Wound Condition.

name: Anticipatory Shell
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target gains +1 Fortitude against the next attack targeting it and reduces its next incoming forced movement by 2 units until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Move the target 1 unit along a clear path.
surge2_html: The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, choose the first visible attacker to miss the protected creature before your next turn; impose -1 on its next Success Die before your next turn.

name: Partitioned Distress
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. The target also gains +1 Composure against pain during that time.
surge1_html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Also suppress one ordinary Poison penalty for the same duration.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, the target may move 1 unit when it next suffers Damage before your next turn, after the Damage resolves.

name: Mnemonic Shelter
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Psychic or Arcane Damage by 2 until the start of your next turn; it knows the direction of that effect's source after resolution.
surge1_html: Extend the protection to Radiant or Necrotic Damage as well.
surge2_html: Also suppress one ordinary sensory impairment on the target until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, leave a mental landmark in the target's space: you ignore ordinary concealment when targeting that space with Psionics until the start of your next turn.

name: Remote Pressure Point
target_html: One enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Force Damage and push it 1 unit.
surge1_html: Choose any horizontal direction for the push.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target's space becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, keep a pressure point in the target's original space until the start of your next turn; the first enemy voluntarily entering it is Slowed 1 until your next turn.

name: Witness Without Footsteps
target_html: One visible point within 6 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, perceive from that point and learn when a detected creature within 2 units begins an Action or movement. This grants no extra Reaction.
surge1_html: Increase the viewpoint's sensing radius by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Gain +1 to the targeted Defense against the next attack originating in that radius until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, your next Psionics Reaction triggered by a creature in the watched area ignores ordinary concealment before your next turn.

name: One Mind, Two Horizons
target_html: Self and one willing ally within 4 units, or self alone.
effect_html: Unopposed. Share simple combat warnings until the start of your next turn. Each target ignores the next ordinary distraction penalty affecting a Combat Card during that time.
surge1_html: One target may move 1 unit toward the other; alone, you may move 1 unit.
surge2_html: Each target gains +1 Composure until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, the first time a linked target is missed before your next turn, it may move 1 unit without triggering that attacker's movement Reactions.

name: Discontinuity of Motion
target_html: One living enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: On success, the target is Slowed 2 and suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Learn whether the target has more Action or Reaction Dice remaining.
surge2_html: On a hit, it must burn 1 die before its next voluntary movement until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and hit, you may move 1 unit after the target next moves before your next turn.

name: The Repeating Error
target_html: One detected enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Psychic Damage; impose -1 on its next Success Die if it repeats the Combat Card it used most recently until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The penalty also applies if it selects the same target again.
surge2_html: On a hit, it is Distracted until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and the target repeats that card before your next turn, it is Slowed 1 until your next turn after resolving the card.

name: Sever the Attention
target_html: One detected enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, suppress one ordinary accuracy bonus on the target until the start of your next turn, up to 1, and reveal its occupied space to allies for that duration.
surge1_html: Learn which Defense the target's last attack contested.
surge2_html: On a hit, deal 1 Psychic Damage.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and hit, the target cannot benefit from ordinary concealment against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.

name: Somatic Quiet
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Do not accept Strain on this card. Remove 1 Strain; suppress one ordinary pain or Poison penalty until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Enter Somatic Trance until the end of your next turn: ignore 1 point of the Composure penalty caused by your current Strain. The Strain remains and other penalties still apply.

name: The Interval Before Choice
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Choose a detected enemy within 5 units. Gain +1 to the Defense targeted by its next attack against you until the start of your next turn; learn its remaining Reaction Dice.
surge1_html: Move 1 unit toward a space with a clear view of it.
surge2_html: Gain the defensive benefit against a second detected enemy within 5 units.
rider_html: Enter Interval Trance until the end of your next turn: the first time the chosen enemy misses you during the Trance, you may remove 1 Strain, provided you accepted none on this card.

name: The Weightless Argument
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Move up to 2 units, ignoring the first difficult space. Reduce your next incoming forced movement by 2 units until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Gain +1 Composure against hostile influence until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Enter Weightless Trance until the end of your next turn: if you accepted Strain on this card, you may stand from Prone on your turn without burning a die; otherwise your next leap may cross a 1-unit gap.

name: Cathedral of Pressure
target_html: Enemies in a sphere of radius 1 centered within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, each takes 1 Force Damage and is pushed 1 unit away from the center.
surge1_html: The center remains difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Force Damage to one hit target.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, leave a pressure imprint in one empty area space until the start of your next turn; its first enemy entrant is pushed 1 unit away after entry.

name: A Pain Without a Wound
target_html: One living enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 Psychic Damage. The target suffers -1 Composure against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of its next ordinary numerical attack bonus until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and hit, gain +1 Composure against the target until the start of your next turn; no existing injury on either creature changes.

name: Causality Under Protest
target_html: Self and one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and gains +1 Fortitude against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Each may move 1 unit toward cover.
surge2_html: One protected target reduces that Damage by 1 more.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, the first protected target to be missed before your next turn may move 1 unit without triggering movement Reactions.

name: Cognitive Quarantine
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary hostile mental Condition until the start of your next turn; reduce its next incoming Psychic or Arcane Damage by 1 during that time.
surge1_html: Gain +1 Composure on the target until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one non-Critical mental Wound Condition's numerical penalties for the same duration.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, the target cannot receive a second copy of the suppressed ordinary Condition from the same source before your next turn; different effects still apply.

name: Architecture of a Second Self
target_html: One visible empty space within 5 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Create an intangible viewpoint until the start of your next turn. Perceive from it and use it as the origin of your next Psionics Action, measuring range from it. It cannot cross solid barriers.
surge1_html: Move the viewpoint up to 2 units before that next Action.
surge2_html: Ignore ordinary concealment against detected targets within 2 units of the viewpoint.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, when the viewpoint expires you may move 2 units toward its last location without triggering movement Reactions.

name: The Shared Horizon
target_html: Self and up to two willing allies within 4 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, each target ignores its next ordinary sensory penalty and gains +1 Defense against the next attack targeting it from a detected enemy.
surge1_html: Each ally may move 1 unit toward you.
surge2_html: Extend the sensory suppression through the end of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, the first linked creature damaged before your next turn may move 1 unit after the Damage; this can be you.

name: Consent of Inert Matter
target_html: One enemy or unattended object within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, move the enemy 2 units horizontally along a clear path and deal 1 Force Damage. An unattended light object instead moves 3 units without opposition.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: On a hit, suppress the target's ordinary benefit from the cover it just left until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, leave a kinetic brace in the destination until the start of your next turn: its occupant resists the next 2 units of forced movement; you may choose not to brace an enemy.

name: Motor Pattern Collapse
target_html: One living enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 1 Psychic Damage and make it Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: On a hit, impose -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Knock the target Prone on a hit.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and hit, the target must burn 1 die before standing from Prone or ending an ordinary restraint before your next turn; this is an added cost, not a canceled Action.

name: The Unreliable Present
target_html: Up to two detected enemies within 5 units and 2 units of each other.
effect_html: On success, each is Distracted and suffers -1 Composure until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Each hit target also has -1 on its next ranged Success Die until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Deal 1 Psychic Damage to one hit target.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain, choose one hit target: when it next changes targets between Actions before your next turn, you may move 1 unit and learn its remaining Reaction Dice.

name: A Name for the Silence
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Unopposed. Do not accept Strain on this card. Remove 2 Strain from yourself and suppress one ordinary mental or pain Condition on the target until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on the target until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Enter Silence Trance until the end of your next turn: you cannot accept Strain, but gain +1 Composure. End the Trance voluntarily only at the start of your turn.

name: The Room Behind the Eyes
target_html: Self.
effect_html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, detect moving creatures within 3 units through ordinary concealment and gain +1 Composure against sensory effects.
surge1_html: Increase detection radius by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Mark one detected enemy; ordinary concealment cannot hide its occupied space from you until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: Enter Inner Room Trance until the end of your next turn: the first Psionics card you use against a marked enemy may ignore 1 point of cover bonus; using this benefit ends the Trance.

name: Vector Without Resistance
target_html: One enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: On success, deal 2 Force Damage and suppress its ordinary concealment against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: On a hit, move the target 1 unit sideways.
surge2_html: On a hit, the target cannot make movement Reactions until the start of your next turn.
rider_html: If you accepted Strain and hit, you may move 1 unit to mirror the target's new position after its next voluntary movement before your next turn.
